Anvil.description: Has high damage output and headshot damage, but slow handling.

Arpeggio.description: Has decent damage output and accuracy.

Bettina.description: Has slow fire rate and high damage output.

Bobcat.description: Has a high fire rate but low accuracy.

Burletta.description: Has decent damage output and accuracy.

Canto.description: Fully automatic submachine gun with a larger caliber

Dolabra.description: An experimental weapon that can either fire a wide short range blast, or be focused to fire a tight medium range beam of heat.

Equalizer.description: A high capacity experimental beam rifle.

Ferro.description: Packs a punch, but must be reloaded between every shot.

Hairpin.description: Has a built-in silencer. Great for stealth, but tricky in combat.

Hullcracker.description: Fires explosive projectiles that only detonate when hitting ARC.

Il Toro.description: Has a large bullet spread, sharp falloff, and high damage output.

Jupiter.description: A bolt-action sniper rifle with exceptional damage output and accuracy, but slow handling.

Kettle.description: Quick and accurate, but has low bullet velocity and takes a long time reload.

Osprey.description: Has reliable damage output and accuracy.

Rattler.description: A cheap offensive option, but has to be reloaded 2 bullets at a time.

Renegade.description: Has high damage output, accuracy, and headshot damage.

Stitcher.description: Deals good damage, but has quite a low fire-rate and can be hard to control.

Tempest.description: Has moderate fire rate and accuracy.

Torrente.description: Has a large ammo capacity, but is only accurate while crouched.

Venator.description: Semi-automatic pistol. Fires two shots at a time.

Vulcano.description: Has good bullet spread but sharp falloff.

Anvil Splitter.description: Tech mod for the Anvil that replaces its bullets with ones that split into 4 weaker projectiles.

Extended Light Mag I.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use light ammo.

Extended Light Mag II.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of the compatible weapons that use light ammo.

Extended Light Mag III.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of the compatible weapons that use light ammo.

Extended Medium Mag I.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.

Extended Medium Mag II.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.

Extended Medium Mag III.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use medium ammo.

Extended Shotgun Mag I.description: Slightly extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.

Extended Shotgun Mag II.description: Moderately extends the ammo capacity of compatible weapons that use shotgun ammo.

Extended Shotgun Mag III.description: Significantly extends the ammo capacity of shotguns.

Horizontal Grip.description: Moderately reduces both vertical recoil and horizontal recoil.

Muzzle Brake I.description: Slightly reduces both vertical recoil & horizontal recoil.

Muzzle Brake II.description: Moderately reduces both vertical recoil & horizontal recoil.

Muzzle Brake III.description: Significantly reduces both vertical recoil & horizontal recoil.

Shotgun Silencer.description: Moderately reduces the amount of noise produced when firing.

Silencer I.description: Slightly reduces the amount of noise produced when firing.

Silencer II.description: Moderately reduces the amount of noise produced when firing.

Silencer III.description: Significantly reduces the amount of noise produced when firing.

Stable Stock I.description: Slightly improves dispersion & recoil recovery time.

Stable Stock II.description: Slightly improves dispersion & recoil recovery time.

Stable Stock III.description: Significantly improves dispersion & recoil recovery time
